canonical_comparisons: Point and midpoint elasticity differ in derivative/local versus finite interval definitions; price signs not absolutized. No demand/supply clone.
Annualized endpoint growth includes CAGR m1 annual periods; no separate renamed CAGR or quarterly-annually special-case record.

Laspeyres/Paasche are fixed-basket valuations with different declared q_b profiles in one canonical basket relationship. Fisher is an independently defined geometric combination. No inflation-percent or reversed-index clones.

Current price GDP sum, GNP cross-border income adjustment, NDP depreciation adjustment, gross domestic purchases and final sales define distinct independently meaningful aggregates. Their inverses are not additional records.
Saving is PI-O-T. DPI=PI-T independently defines after-tax income; S=DPI-O is not a second saving record. Saving rate independently normalizes the saving amount.

Average total cost, unit labor cost and mean transaction price share quotient shape but have different source-defined numerator scopes. They are not algebraically equivalent relationships among identical quantities.
Finite marginal cost is an endpoint secant under one unchanged cost schedule; continuous derivative deferred rather than mislabeled.
singularity_review: For quotient inverses with output0 and numerator0, positive/nonzero original denominator is generally unidentified. Inconsistent output0 and nonzero numerator has no solution. Original numerator/output sign guards retained.
Point elasticity: s=e=0 leaves positive P,Q unidentified; signed s,e required. Arc k=1,Q1=0 leaves any Q2>0, while k=1,Q1>0 inconsistent.
Geometric growth: g0 equal endpoints cannot identify m/n or elapsed count. Positive endpoints exclude gross growth<=0; no negative-root branch.
Break-even: F0,Q_be0 leaves p>v unidentified; p=v excluded by unique positive-contribution profile, even though zero fixed expense could yield zero income at any volume.
Fisher: principal nonnegative root only; L0,F0 leaves scalar P unspecified, subject to underlying shared basket constraints. Same applies interchanging L/P.
Signed saving-rate denominator: DPI may have either sign but cannot be0; saving0/rate0 does not reveal DPI. No probability bound.

Operating leverage: CM0,D0 permits negative NOI in declared CM>=NOI profile; zero NOI always excluded. CM is not independently constrained nonnegative because declared signed sales regime may have negative contribution.
Margin of safety: B0,m1 admits any S>0; B>0,m1 impossible. Model is descriptive actual-sales accounting, not demand forecasting.
Additive account identities have no algebraic denominator singularities, but a single residual cannot determine two missing component amounts or economic classifications.

U-6: r6=1 requires LF=U+P and leaves marginal attachment unidentified; r6=0 forces U=A=P0 and leaves positive LF unidentified. LF0,Apositive valid; LF+A0 excluded. P already inside LF, so no denominator double count.
integration_and_rights_review: All35 records require extension; no runtime-ready claims. New meaning/unit metadata must preserve price bases, persons versus jobs, stocks versus interval flows and source/reference vintage.

CAD_ref reference_currency is an explicit account-valuation dimension tag. Other USD_ref records retain currency dimensional algebra and encode reference basis in unit/context. Neither convention authorizes cross-currency or nominal-real binding; normalization is a future integration concern.

OpenStax live license footer and AI-use restriction, CORE NC-ND terms, IMF no-redistribution footer, BEA incomplete license findings, BLS public-domain exceptions, WB additional terms and StatCan open-license attribution are recorded; no blanket rights clearance asserted.

Some primary PDFs could not be visually inspected because screenshot tool returned no image blocks. Only unambiguous extracted equations supported by prose/other primary HTML were completed; ambiguous vector formulas deferred.
